reason: I buy for a compliance-first shop, so I need SSO, audit log, and FIPS before any purchase, and the pitch mentions none of them. Layered on top is my lock-in fear: if Loom shuts down, my agents' context is trapped. At $30 a seat I won't buy a tool I can't get my data out of.
objection: Lock-in — if Loom shuts down my context is locked in, and there's no mention of SSO, audit log, or FIPS for compliance procurement.
would_change_my_mind: Data export/portability or self-hosting so nothing is locked in, plus SSO, audit log, and FIPS support.
